# SYNESIS_E159 — Warning

## Description

No instruction (INSTRUCTION <text> or MAP <field> TO INSTRUCTION).

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: no instruction. Write `INSTRUCTION <text>` (same instruction on
  every line) or `MAP <field> TO INSTRUCTION` (instruction taken from a field).
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **AlpacaInstructionSource**: `block`, `both`
